missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend an additional B12 product until product amount, frequency and fortified-food intake are reconciled.
safety_exclusions: Do not treat current supplement use as proof of adequate status without considering adherence and absorption.
Do not duplicate B12 products automatically.
Do not delay clinical evaluation of neurological symptoms or suspected malabsorption.
professional_escalation_conditions: Neurological symptoms, pernicious anemia, malabsorption, gastrointestinal surgery or abnormal B12 labs.
population_and_context: Vegan users already taking B12; determine total intake from supplements and fortified foods before suggesting any additional product.
dose_constraints: No additional dose from this rule; reconcile total reliable B12 sources and follow clinical advice if deficiency is suspected.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS B12 fact sheet supports reliable fortified and supplemental sources; actual adequacy depends on dose, adherence and absorption. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
